definitions.explanation: A tooth, usually an upper canine, that grows out of line and overlaps or sticks out over its neighbors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{八重歯|やえば}だ。
⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{八重歯|やえば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: When she smiles, her snaggletooth shows.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{八重歯|やえば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かわいい→かわいい：00857_kawaii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{矯正|きょうせい}→矯正：14784_kyousei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Snaggleteeth used to be called cute, but these days many people have them straightened.

notes:
⟦{八重|やえ}→八重：29805_yae⟧ (many-layered, double) + ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧ (tooth).

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan a snaggletooth has long been seen as cute or charming, especially in young women and in anime characters, unlike in many Western countries. Today orthodontic treatment (⟦{歯列|しれつ}→歯列：32476_shiretsu⟧⟦{矯正|きょうせい}→矯正：14784_kyousei⟧) to straighten it is also common.
